name: Honjou Erii
source: Erii Honjou is the girlfriend of Shirou Yusa. She is the daughter of a well off family, with her grandfather owning a well known hospital. While by day, she was an honors student at a prestigious school, she secretly moonlights as a rebellious hacker.
